coverage.en: The archive is incomplete. A confirmation is a statement by the General Staff, SBU, HUR, SSO, Unmanned Systems Forces, OC South, StratCom or Valerii Zaluzhnyi; the archive so far contains only General Staff confirmations (in 2022 sometimes the Commander-in-Chief): 2022 — occupied territories only, as the General Staff did not confirm strikes inside russia then; 2023 — the General Staff rarely named targets (only a few ships and the Black Sea Fleet HQ); 2024 — from the General Staff's Telegram posts; 2025 — from the General Staff's Telegram posts (except targets in occupied areas with no named town); 2026 — January–September, the most complete.
